data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add (a) token-usage capture to the reviewer-dispatcher so that Anthropic API response `usage.input_tokens` and `usage.output_tokens` are written to `${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/review-cycle-usage.json` after each reviewer dispatch; (b) `telemetry-emit.sh` invocations at the right points in the dispatch flow to emit `review_finding`, `resolver_outcome`, `arbiter_ruling`, `tool_finding`, and `review_cycle` events with `--key`/`--link` wiring for cross-event linkage.
**Why**: This is the integration that produces real-world telemetry — without it, sc-9 cannot be observed. The live self-use validation story (draft-10) requires reviewer-dispatcher to emit events that land in S3.
**Scope**:
- IN: Dispatcher modifications, usage-json write, telemetry-emit.sh invocation calls, --key/--link wiring.
- OUT: Live verification (separate story). Schema document or emit utility (separate stories).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, after a `/dso:review` run, `${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/review-cycle-usage.json` contains Anthropic API `usage.input_tokens` and `usage.output_tokens` for each reviewer dispatch.
  ← Satisfies: sc-9  (sc-9: "reviewer-dispatcher emits real telemetry event during d2f9 sprint")
- When this story is complete, after a `/dso:review` run, the reviewer-dispatcher has invoked `telemetry-emit.sh` for each applicable event type (review_cycle always; review_finding/resolver_outcome/arbiter_ruling/tool_finding when applicable).
  ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, telemetry emissions use `--key`/`--link` to establish `finding_event_id` linkage between `review_finding` and downstream `resolver_outcome`/`arbiter_ruling` events.
  ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, when `telemetry.endpoint` is set to the deployed Function URL, at least one event is observed in S3 within 60s of `/dso:review` completion.
  ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, total `/dso:review` wallclock time increases by no more than 500ms (95th percentile across 10 runs) compared to baseline with `telemetry.endpoint` unset, as measured with a mock endpoint simulating 50ms latency.
  ← Satisfies: sc-9

## Considerations

- [Backward compatibility] If `telemetry.endpoint` is unset or empty, the dispatcher must skip emission silently without breaking the review run.
- [Cost] Capturing usage adds zero latency — read it from the response object already in memory.
- [Linkage] `event-id-map.json` keys should be stable across the review-cycle lifetime so resolver/arbiter events can link back.
- [Latency budget] Telemetry emission must be async or fire-and-forget (or bounded by a hard 200ms per-emission timeout) to avoid adding seconds of wallclock time to review runs.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a /dso:review user, I want the reviewer-dispatcher to capture Anthropic API token usage and emit telemetry events via telemetry-emit.sh, so that every review run produces canonical telemetry to the central endpoint.
